compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a list of South American countries along with corresponding data sizes in megabytes (mb) next to each country name. The countries listed include Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Columbia, Ecuador, French Guyana, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, and Venezuela. Each country name is followed by a numerical value representing the data size associated with that country. The interface appears to be a data management or storage overview, possibly showing the amount of data used or available for each country.
